local W=workspace:FindFirstChild("FantasySurvivalWorld") local char=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local best={} 
for _,m in ipairs(W:GetChildren()) do if m:IsA("Model") then local sp=m:GetAttribute("Species") or m:GetAttribute("MeadowWildlife")
 if (sp=="wolf" or sp=="deer") and hrp then local d=(m:GetPivot().Position-hrp.Position).Magnitude
  if not best[sp] or d<best[sp].d then best[sp]={m=m,d=d} end end end end
local o={}
for sp,b in pairs(best) do local m=b.m
 table.insert(o,sp.." "..m.Name.." d="..string.format("%.0f",b.d).." mot="..tostring(m:GetAttribute("NativeMobMotion")).." rig="..tostring(m:GetAttribute("NativeCreatureRigMode")).." pivotLook="..tostring(m:GetPivot().LookVector))
 for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("Bone") then local k=d.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
  if k:find("leg") or k:find("bone0") then
   local x,y,z=d.Transform:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
   local wl=d.WorldCFrame
   table.insert(o,string.format("  %s T=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) wpos=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) wX=(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f) wY=(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f)",d.Name,math.deg(x),math.deg(y),math.deg(z),wl.Position.X,wl.Position.Y,wl.Position.Z,wl.RightVector.X,wl.RightVector.Y,wl.RightVector.Z,wl.UpVector.X,wl.UpVector.Y,wl.UpVector.Z))
  end end end
end
print(table.concat(o,"\n")) return table.concat(o,"\n")
